partners.mechanism_chain: C7 (HGNC:2148) —DISRUPTS→ Complement cascade activation (GO:0006955); C5 (HGNC:2145) —DISRUPTS→ Complement cascade activation (GO:0006955); Complement cascade activation (GO:0006955) —LEADS_TO→ Membrane attack complex formation (GO:0070642); Membrane attack complex formation (GO:0070642) —LEADS_TO→ Recurrent bacterial infections (HP:00114203); Membrane attack complex formation (GO:0070642) —LEADS_TO→ Neisseria infections (HP:0010861). Loss-of-function mutations in C7 or C5 disrupt the complement cascade. C5 is essential for the formation of the membrane attack complex (MAC), and C7 is a component of the MAC. Deficiencies in either C5 or C7 impair MAC formation, leading to increased susceptibility to certain bacterial infections, particularly Neisseria species.

partners.mechanism_chain: C7 (HGNC:1464) —DISRUPTS→ Terminal Complement Complex (TCC) Formation (GO:0034220); CFP (HGNC:2209) —DISRUPTS→ Complement System Activation (GO:0006955); Complement System Activation (GO:0006955) —INCREASES→ Terminal Complement Complex (TCC) Formation (GO:0034220); Terminal Complement Complex (TCC) Formation (GO:0034220) —LEADS_TO→ Recurrent bacterial infections (HP:0002714); Terminal Complement Complex (TCC) Formation (GO:0034220) —LEADS_TO→ Increased susceptibility to Neisseria infections (HP:0002717). #### 1. complement component 5 deficiency  —  Tier 3 — Moderate / Emerging  (fitness 0.472)
**Link type:** shared pathway (Reactome:R-HSA-166665, Reactome:R-HSA-977606)

**Proposed mechanism:** C7 (HGNC:2148) —DISRUPTS→ Complement cascade activation (GO:0006955); C5 (HGNC:2145) —DISRUPTS→ Complement cascade activation (GO:0006955); Complement cascade activation (GO:0006955) —LEADS_TO→ Membrane attack complex formation (GO:0070642); Membrane attack complex formation (GO:0070642) —LEADS_TO→ Recurrent bacterial infections (HP:00114203); Membrane attack complex formation (GO:0070642) —LEADS_TO→ Neisseria infections (HP:0010861). Loss-of-function mutations in C7 or C5 disrupt the complement cascade. C5 is essential for the formation of the membrane attack complex (MAC), and C7 is a component of the MAC. Deficiencies in either C5 or C7 impair MAC formation, leading to increased susceptibility to certain bacterial infections, particularly Neisseria species.

**How to falsify it:** If individuals with homozygous loss-of-function variants in C7 or C5 do not exhibit increased susceptibility to bacterial infections, particularly Neisseria species, this hypothesis would be falsified. _(variant: A common pathogenic variant in C7 or C5 (e.g., allele frequency > 0.01 in gnomAD) would challenge the rarity of these diseases and the proposed mechanism.)_

**Why it matters:** Understanding the shared downstream consequences of C5 and C7 deficiency on complement-mediated bacterial killing could inform therapeutic strategies aimed at restoring complement function or providing alternative immune support for patients with these rare conditions.
